items.body:
The framework tree is currently red on an Engine roll here https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/99459.

https://ci.chromium.org/ui/p/flutter/builders/prod/Mac_ios%20platform_views_scroll_perf_ios__timeline_summary/3818/overview

It looks like the main thread is crashing in a call to `GrMtlIsAppInBackground()`.

The Engine roll contains a clang roll. I will revert the Engine roll, stop the Engine rollers, and then speculatively revert the clang rolls if the framework tree returns to green.
